{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is integer, then group by patient_id and keep max
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check if site and severity are associated
site_severity_ct = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['site'], df_dedup['severity'])
print("Cross-tabulation of site vs severity:")
print(site_severity_ct)

# Compute overall response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100
print("\nResponse rate by site (%):")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Check if site and severity are associated (chi-squared test)
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(site_severity_ct)
print(f"\nChi-squared test: chi2 = {chi2:.3f}, p = {p:.3f}")"}
